meta.title: Invoice Assignment for Processing: refused for a user without the AP Manager role
gaps: Sign in as the non-AP Manager user and attempt Invoice Assignment for Processing to verify it is refused or absent.
Repeat the workflow as an AP Manager and verify it is available and can route invoices.
Compare both role outcomes on the same Growth tenant and record any deliberate RBAC configuration that grants access to additional roles.
